## Withheld items and why

* `propeller-kp505-kt-design-point` (propeller-open-water) -- recomputed error 29.1257% exceeds the declared tolerance 3%
* `propeller-kp505-eta0-worst-physical-point` (propeller-open-water) -- recomputed error 24.3849% exceeds the declared tolerance 5%

## Accepted gaps (honest FAIL, registered)

* `propeller-kp505-kt-design-point` (propeller-open-water): The KP505 lattice closes to |dK_T| = 29.1% at J = 0.8 against the 3% design-point criterion (verdict.json status FAIL, 2/3 criteria failed). Registered as an accepted gap so the honest FAIL stays visible; closing it needs the unpublished chord/radial pitch particulars or a higher-fidelity lifting-surface model, not a tolerance change.
* `propeller-kp505-eta0-worst-physical-point` (propeller-open-water): Worst efficiency error inside the physical J range is 24.4% at J = 0.9 against the 5% band (1 of 10 anchor points meets the band). Accepted gap, same model/geometry cause as the K_T row; the J = 1.0 outlier (787%) is outside the physical range and is reported in verdict.json rather than scored here.

## Structural/numeric disagreement

A capability counts as backed only when both layers agree. These rows are
declared `REAL` by the structural audit but are not backed by a number that
meets its own criterion -- they are overstated claims, kept visible on purpose:

* `propeller-open-water` (item `propeller-kp505-kt-design-point`): structural REAL vs numeric WITHHELD -- recomputed error 29.1257% exceeds the declared tolerance 3%
* `propeller-open-water` (item `propeller-kp505-eta0-worst-physical-point`): structural REAL vs numeric WITHHELD -- recomputed error 24.3849% exceeds the declared tolerance 5%
